player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''CJ''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list on DeckTech in September 2000.

starting.card: Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die

description: Capture characters and feed them to theRancor.
cards: Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die
notes: Total 60 as published. The strategy says to start All Wrapped Up and two other Effects depending on the matchup (There Is No Try, You Cannot Hide Forever, Resistance or Secret Plans); several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set. Prepared Defenses is in the list but the post does not name it as a starting card.
'Grabber' is shown as posted (UNKNOWN): no Dark card of that name existed in September 2000 (Allegations Of Corruption is a Coruscant card, August 2001).

Posted 'Court' dested Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die; 'JPAC', 'JPDungeon', 'JPRancor Pit' the Jabba's Palace sites; 'TGreat Pit' Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon; 'TJP x2' Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (a unique site, posted twice); 'TCantina' Tatooine: Cantina; 'ExDB' Executor: Docking Bay; 'DS2DB' Death Star II: Docking Bay.

Posted 'Jabba x2' dested the Special Edition character Jabba (exact title; the Jabba's Palace card is Jabba The Hutt); 'EPP Fett' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'EJP Dengar' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'ECC 4-LOM' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'ECC IG-88' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'CC Engineer' Cloud City Engineer; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Mara 's Saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber.

Posted 'ZiMH', 'BiHT', 'DiP1' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, Bossk In Hound's Tooth, Dengar In Punishing One; 'Twi'lek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Oota Goota, Solo?' Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?. Secret Plans and Resistance are the older Effects (not the Reflections III Defensive Shields).
The strategy says the deck is based on Steven Lewis' deck at the Nashville Grand Slam; this post itself is not a tournament report.
